title: volvulus atriplicifolius
intro: Volvulus atriplicifolius, commonly known as Volvulus or desert holly, is a plant species used in traditional medicine. It is valued for its health benefits, which include the treatment of fever, inflammation, and gastrointestinal issues due to its antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and gastroprotective properties. The therapeutic actions of Volvulus are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory effects. The plant has been used to treat various health conditions, and its extracts have been studied for their potential in developing new medicines.
